learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to classify the most important control and regulation systems occurring in practice and analyze their properties.
They can apply the insights gained with regard to the selection of a suitable control/regulation strategy.
They are also able to systematically design controls/regulations in the time or image and frequency domain.
Furthermore, they are familiar with the basics for implementing/programming control and regulation algorithms, especially on programmable logic controllers.

syllabus_topics: Introduction (definitions, norms, examples, design procedure, goals)
Binary controls (logic circuits, operation of PLCs, programming with FUP/AS)
Continuous transmission systems (classification, elementary transmission elements, block diagram, linearization)
Description and analysis of LTI systems in the image and frequency domain (transfer function, frequency response representations, stability criteria)
Design of single-loop control systems (design requirements, tuning rules, design in the image domain, design based on frequency characteristics)
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
